newsitem.title: MEXICO: Posadas plans Latin America expansion.
newsitem.headline: Posadas plans Latin America expansion.

text.p: Grupo Posadas, Mexico's leading hotel operator, plans to enter into partnership with Latin American investors for an expansion strategy, a top executive from the company told Reuters.
"As a regional strategy, we are covering the southern United States and want to expand towards Central and South America," said Genaro Marquez, assistant director general at Posadas.
Grupo Posadas already operates hotels in Chile, Peru, Venezuela and Colombia, under its brand names Fiesta Americana and Fiesta Inn, he said.

"Our strategy envisages promoting hotel development, as there is little supply of quality hotels in the region ... we are seeking to promote participation by regional investors in these projects," he added.
Posadas began to operate hotels in Venezuela three years ago, and the group now plans to build a hotel in the capital city, Caracas, to buttress its market presence in the country.

"We already have a couple of properties in operation in Venezuela, and noe have a site in Caracas to build a hotel along with Venezuelan investors," Marquez said, although he did not name any possible partners.
Marquez said that in the U.S., Posadas had achieved its best market presence in the states of Texas and in some parts of California, New Mexico and Arizona.
Posadas' planned investments for an unspecified amount in international expansion are part off its global plan for potential markets, he said.
Grupo Posadas operates 41 hotels with a total of 9,880 rooms in the Western Hemisphere. -- Mexico City newsroom +525 728-9549
